about: A help desk agent hands a Wi-Fi problem to the network expert. The expert searches the school IT help sheet (part of the run) and answers with the steps. Both agents run on Anthropic (paid).
how: An agent answers with an action: hand off to another agent with a note, or finish. The expert never sees the whole help sheet: it calls the search tool, and the tool returns only the passages that fit the query.
learns: In a handoff control moves forward and the note is all the next agent knows. The expert reads the help sheet only through a search tool, never whole.
watch: The note of the handoff (all the next agent knows), the two search rows (what was asked, which passages came back) and how the answer follows the sheet.
